```{r}
#| label: fig-sim-distribution
#| fig-cap: >
#|   Distribution of simulated antibody responses, by antigen-isotype.
library(ggbeeswarm)

sim_data |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = as.factor(antigen_iso), y = value) +
  geom_beeswarm(
    size = .5, alpha = .5,
    aes(color = antigen_iso), show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, fill = NA) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_linedraw() +
  labs(x = "antigen - isotype")
```
